description: This file defines a PHP class for interfacing with Microsoft Access databases via ODBC. It includes driver-specific settings, connection management, and recordset handling for Access.

classes.name: ADODB_access
classes.description: A PHP class representing an Access database driver that extends the ODBC driver with Access-specific configurations and methods.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_access
classes.description: A PHP class for handling record sets returned from Access database queries, extending the ODBC record set handling.

methods.name: ADODB_access
methods.description: Constructor for the ADODB_access class, initializes the driver and sets global extension flag.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Stub method indicating that transactions are not supported in this driver.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns SQL expression to handle null fields using Access-specific syntax.
